headline: Neighbor Rescues 4-Year-Old from Burning House with Bare Hands
meta_description: A Mississippi man risked his life searching through smoldering wreckage to pull a trapped 4-year-old boy from a house fire in Edwards.
summary_short: Neighbor Kennard Hodge dug through burning rubble with his bare hands to rescue a trapped young child from a house fire in Mississippi.
body:
A Mississippi neighbor risked his life to pull a 4-year-old boy from a burning home, searching through smoldering wreckage with nothing but his bare hands.

Kennard Hodge was among those searching through the rubble of a house fire in Edwards, Hinds County, when he located the trapped child. Body camera footage from police captured the moment Hodge dug through the scorched debris, his voice urgent as he called out to others: "Got him, got him. I got him!"

Hodge's swift action and willingness to enter the dangerous wreckage turned what could have been a tragedy into a story of community courage. His search through the flames and ash—armed only with determination—reminds us that ordinary people can perform extraordinary acts of bravery when a life hangs in the balance.
quick_facts: Neighbor Kennard Hodge rescued the boy from burning wreckage
4-year-old trapped inside house fire in Edwards, Hinds County, Mississippi
Hodge searched through smoldering debris with his bare hands
Police body camera footage documented the dramatic rescue
